title: SynthesisResult
description: Canonical contracted schema for Phase 08.4G deterministic result synthesis.

workflow_id.description: Unique identifier of the executed workflow.

workflow_version.description: Version of the executed workflow definition.

status.description: Overall terminal status of the result synthesis.

synthesis_eligible.description: Flag indicating whether the workflow output met the 08.4F Join Gate eligibility criteria for synthesis.

task_attributions.description: Deterministic, declared-order collection of per-task outputs preserving attribution and worker terminal states.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent that executed or was assigned to the task.

status.description: Terminal outcome of the worker/task execution.

findings.description: Raw structured data extracted or generated by the agent/task.

artifacts.description: File paths or URIs created/modified by the task.

errors.description: Error messages recorded during task execution, if any.

aggregated_findings.description: Consolidated findings aggregated strictly in declared workflow order, preserving task attribution without deduplication or reordering.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task from which this finding originated.

errors.description: Structured list of errors encountered across the workflow and individual steps.

provenance.description: Execution, reconciliation, and synthesis provenance metadata passed intact for 08.4H verification.
